ops.title: Machine-wide slowdown: bundled ugrep 7.5.0 busy-loops on .claude/fragments/.gitignore
ops.body:
Recurring symptom: git commands and new shell startup crawl; many processes pegged at ~100% CPU. `ps` shows them as `ugrep` (argv[0] is rewritten via `ARGV0=ugrep`, so the real binary is the Claude Code executable — `pgrep -x yes` and similar hunches find nothing).

## Root cause

Claude Code's shell snapshot (`~/.claude/shell-snapshots/snapshot-zsh-*.sh`, section `# Shadow find/grep with embedded bfs/ugrep`) defines `grep` as a shell function that routes every call to the **bundled ugrep 7.5.0** with:

```
ugrep -G --ignore-files --hidden -I --exclude-dir=.git ... "$@"
```

`--ignore-files` defaults to looking for `.gitignore`. cc-guides' fragment store names each fragment directory after its target file, so **`.claude/fragments/.gitignore` is a directory, not a file**. ugrep 7.5.0 opens it as an ignore file and busy-loops forever in `select()`/`fread()` at 100% CPU — never returns, never emits output, and survives the Bash tool call that spawned it.

`--hidden` is what makes `.claude/` reachable in an ordinary project-scoped search.

## Confirmed by

- `sample <pid>`: 2474 of 2575 stacks in `__select`, remainder in `fread`/`__read_nocancel`.
- `lsof <pid>`: `8r DIR .../.claude/fragments/.gitignore` — the ignore file is open as a DIR.

## Isolation (same fixture, same flags)

| Binary | Flags | Result |
|---|---|---|
| bundled ugrep 7.5.0 | `--ignore-files --hidden` | hangs, ~99% CPU |
| bundled ugrep 7.5.0 | no `--ignore-files` | finishes |
| upstream ugrep 7.8.2 (Homebrew) | identical | finishes |

Fixed upstream between 7.5.0 and 7.8.2 — a directory named `.gitignore` is legal and upstream handles it.

## Minimal repro

```sh
mkdir -p /tmp/ugrepbug/sub/.gitignore
echo needle > /tmp/ugrepbug/a.txt
cd /tmp/ugrepbug && grep -rn needle .   # in the Bash tool -> hangs at 100% CPU
```
Remember to `rm -rf` the fixture afterwards — the `.gitignore` directory is itself a live landmine for later greps.

## Blast radius

38 such directories: 18 repos under `~/Code` plus every `~/.claude/plugins/marketplaces/*` clone. Every agent `grep` touching one permanently loses a core, and with several concurrent Claude sessions they accumulate. Observed 11 pinned at once, oldest spinning 50 minutes, load average 22.6.

## Immediate relief

`pkill -9 -x ugrep` — reclaims the cores. Measured recovery: `git rev-parse` 0.46s -> 0.26s, `zsh -i` 3.4s -> 2.3s, load 22.6 -> 6.8. They respawn from other live sessions, so this is symptomatic only.

## Status (2026-07-28)

Reported upstream: https://github.com/anthropics/claude-code/issues/81916. No local containment applied by choice. Options deliberately declined at the time, still available if it becomes intolerable: a reaper watchdog killing ugrep older than ~60s; changing the cc-guides fragment layout so fragment dirs aren't named after dotfiles; or a `fragments/` ignore rule (verified to stop the hang, but misses marketplace clones and hides fragments from searches). There is no env toggle to disable the shim — see upstream #69736.
